<thought>The carbon NMR spectrum shows peaks at the following chemical shifts: 147.00, 133.90, 128.91, 127.68, 44.06, 34.54, 26.90, and 26.18 ppm. Each distinct shift corresponds to a unique carbon environment. There are 8 different values, so there are 8 chemically equivalent carbon types.</thought>
<final_answer>8</final_answer>
